svg.title: The first run: aayu tour, then aayu next
svg.desc: A terminal. aayu tour checks the machine, asks which agent you use, runs aayu init (which shows its plan and asks first), installs the skills, and reaches Level 1. aayu next then prints the single next step: aayu grill story. The init plan is shortened to one line.

g.text: $ aayu tour
Atri (Founder's Sage): Counsels the founder as a rajguru counsels a king.
Welcome to aayudha. Three steps take this repository to Level 1: clear work items.
Level 1 adds labels, issue forms, a config file, AGENTS.md, and a records branch. No workflows,
no secrets, no CI minutes.
Step 1 of 3: this machine
✓ PASS Checking git, git-lfs, your GitHub sign-in, and the config: ready (9.7s)
Which host do you work in? amp, cursor, claude, codex [amp]: claude
Step 2 of 3: set up the repository
Running aayu init. It shows exactly what it creates and asks before it uses your admin access.
… one line per label, issue form, config file, AGENTS.md section, and the ledger branch …
Step 3 of 3: skills, MCP server, and hooks for claude
Install the aayudha skills, MCP server, and hooks for claude? [Y/n]: y
★ Level 1! This repository has clear work items. Commit what changed in a pull request.
Next → aayu grill story
Shape your first story with numbered criteria that say what done means, then aayu ready <issue>.
$ aayu next
→ aayu grill story
nothing is waiting: shape the next story, with numbered criteria that say what done means.
(Product Strategist)
